name: RTAF F-16 Fighting Falcon
detail: Six F-16s deployed July 24, 2025 to strike Cambodian 8th/9th Army positions near Ta Muen Thom -- the RTAF's first combat sorties since 1987-88.

name: Cambodian BM-21 Multiple Rocket Launcher
detail: Used by Cambodian forces to strike Thai border towns, reportedly hitting a hospital and residential areas during the July 2025 fighting.

name: Chanthaburi Pilot Fence (BM 52-54)
detail: 1.3km of reinforced concrete panel fencing topped with steel mesh and concertina wire, completed April 2026 as Thailand's first permanent border barrier segment.

name: Aranyaprathet 10km Fence Plan
detail: Approved permanent fence with triple-layer barbed wire and CCTV surveillance planned for a disputed sector near Aranyaprathet.

name: 1,669 Border Shelters & Warning Systems
detail: 433.5 million baht approved in August 2026 to build shelters and improve early-warning/communication systems across seven Thai border provinces.

name: Chong Kal Displacement Camp
detail: Major Cambodian government-run IDP camp in Oddar Meanchey province established during the 2025 escalations.

name: ASEAN Observer Team (AOT)
detail: Philippines-led monitoring mission deployed under the December 27, 2025 ceasefire framework to verify compliance at border checkpoints in both countries.

name: Agreed Troop Deployment Line
detail: Line established at the 3rd Special GBC meeting (Dec 27, 2025) defining where Thai and Cambodian forces may hold position without further movement.

name: Thai 2nd Army Region Border Positions
detail: 11 fortified positions along the frontier that the 2nd Army Region command has pledged not to withdraw from despite ceasefire pressure.

name: RCAF 8th & 9th Infantry Divisions
detail: Cambodian army divisions headquartered near the Preah Vihear/Ta Muen sector, targeted by Thai F-16 strikes on July 24, 2025.

name: Poipet-Aranyaprathet Crossing
detail: Major commercial border crossing repeatedly closed during escalations, disrupting a large share of the ~366.7 billion baht in annual bilateral trade.

name: Thai Border Drone-Detection Systems
detail: Systems cited by the Thai military after reporting hundreds of alleged Cambodian drone incursions in the days following the December 27, 2025 ceasefire.
